items.title: Ernest "Punch" Miller Interview, 1959-09-01
items.q: Sidney Desvien and Amos White are on the record.

ctx.x: He's a big fella? Not too big.
Amos White and Sidney Desvien on the record. What? Sidney Desvien and Amos White are on the record. That's bad.

items.title: Ernest 'Punch' Miller Interview, 1960-08-23
items.q: I didn't know anybody in the Amos band but him.

ctx.x: He's supposed to play with Amos Riley. Oh, well.

How about knowing if I see him yet? Cause I didn't know anybody in the Amos band but him. He's supposed to play with him. Cause he always had new men to meet my idea. Fellas coming in here from the country, you know.
Amos White maybe he played with. I can't remember. Played with Amos White or Amos Riley. I can't remember. Might have been Amos White.
